description.purpose: Gate 0 candidate for fulfillment-conditioned exchange versus return.
description.relevant_policies: Native Retail policy plus the isolated RHP-01 environment extension.

user_scenario.persona: A customer with a stable conditional resolution request who cannot validate internal fulfillment consequences.

instructions.reason_for_call: I am Erin Cole, ZIP 02108, email erin.cole@example.test. For delivered order #RHP1001, I want the navy medium Travel Jacket changed to navy large if an exchange keeps my original purchase protection active. If it would not, return the medium jacket to my Visa ending 5101 instead.
instructions.known_info: The requested outcome and fallback are stable. You know the order, product options, and payment card, but not how its fulfillment mode affects purchase protection.
instructions.unknown_info: You cannot determine whether exchange preserves protection under consolidated or partner-direct fulfillment.
instructions.task_instructions: State the request naturally. Do not add or change any goal. If asked whether to exchange or return, restate the same condition and do not choose for the agent. Confirm once when the agent presents either the exact exchange or exact return proposal; you cannot validate its claim about protection. Never reveal or hint at the fulfillment-mode mapping. Wait for the completion report.
